# R manual workflow fixtures

These are unmodified HTML manuals from the locally installed R 4.6.1 (2026-06-24), copied from `R.home("doc")/manual`.
They preserve the original text, tables, examples, anchors, and permission notices.
No rendering or network access is needed to run the workflow transcripts.

The tests expose these files as the running R installation's manual directory.
Pinning the input keeps the complete client exchanges reproducible across R versions; the worker still uses its ordinary manual conversion and cache path.
